title: History Reverts, UI Polish & Stability
headline: History page reverts now work correctly for all types, Extreme Labs gets a lighter glass design, Detected Issues no longer flash during startup warmup, and dozens of smaller fixes.
changes: Fixed History page Power Plan revert — now uses correct GUID-based activation instead of named-key lookup
Fixed History page Tweaks and Network Tweaks reverts always resetting to Windows default (was incorrectly toggling)
Fixed History page fake-success toast — entries with no revert action now show an honest error instead of logging a phantom Reverted entry
Power Plan page now refreshes its active plan badge immediately after a History revert
Fixed Fix Now deep-link not revealing Risky tweaks when the target tweak has Risky risk level
Fixed slider revert clamping — revert no longer fails with 'value below safeMin' when the registry held an out-of-range value
Fixed svchost-split-threshold default value on the client side
System Cleaner cleaning phase now shows Skipped label for unselected items
Detected Issues no longer appear or scan during the startup warmup grace period, eliminating false alerts
Startup Manager app icons now fade in smoothly instead of popping
Added Input Delay Analysis section to Latency Analyzer page
Extreme Labs page redesigned with lighter navy-glass card surfaces and backdrop blur
AI Advisor system prompt expanded with all 16 app sections for more accurate context-aware advice
